task: quick-pick-survey flagship 8, item d3: slot runs that start partway

errors.what: First sweep launch ran 150 cells at 200 surveys, far too slow on 4 CPUs; killed and relaunched leaner at 100 surveys
Killed the sweep before its last 11 q1 cells (onset 0.75 at 30 items x 4-8, and 0.1-0.4 shares) to land the run; seed2 and items60 cover onset 0.75 at 30 and 60 items

doc_friction.issue: The header comment is ~120 lines of option history; reading it to learn the harness's panel model cost more than reading careless-pattern-sweep.ts, which was the useful template.

For quick-pick-survey it skips (no *.test.mjs) and points at quick-pick-survey-ci.yml; ventures/CLAUDE.md says it is the CI pass for a venture, which is not true for Next.js ventures with their own workflow.

deviations.why: The first 52 sweep cells ran before the 8-answer whole-session rule (slotFlags) was added to the union scheme; I kept those rows rather than re-running for another hour.
deviations.did: Documented in the write-up that those rows keep up to 7 answers of a run starting at once, and checked the onset-0 rows differ by at most 0.0001.

notes: Flagship 8 item d3 landed: slotBlockStarts (exact binomial tail, Bonferroni over starts, alpha 0.01) + slotFlags, default on in the ranking route. Sweep 107 cells x 100 surveys: within -0.0008..+0.0011 of the oracle in all 94 careless cells; honest flags 0.01-0.16% on fair-coin slots. Verified locally: typecheck, lint, test:fast 508 passed, next build OK, ranking integration 10 passed against scripts/test-db.sh Postgres (new test red on the old route), test:simulations (see PR). No new agent doc: the venture's own docs carry the next steps (flagships next: d9 rewritten).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician-engineer designing an exact scan test, a simulation sweep, route wiring and integration tests, and the write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
